name: B10-0208/2024 (Verts/ALE) – Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of pro-democracy activists and journalists jailed in Hong Kong under the national security law. It asks European Union officials to prepare sanctions against Hong Kong and Chinese officials blamed for the crackdown, including Hong Kong's leader John Lee. It also asks European Union countries to stop sending suspected criminals to China and Hong Kong, and to review Hong Kong's special trade status. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament urges sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials; it cannot impose them itself.
- It asks European Union countries to end extradition deals with China and Hong Kong.
- It asks the European Union to review Hong Kong's special trade status and keep watching trials.
